command: SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo pre_call_state=$ST; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); echo apk=$APK; set +e; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe open-abort-offcall" 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; echo probe_exit=$RC; echo post_call_state=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); test "$ST" = "0"; echo phase2_downlink_open_diagnostic_complete=true
